verdict.rationale: Pylon documents built-in analytics dashboards with 'common support metrics' that are filterable, implying resolution/CSAT-type reporting, but no evidence explicitly names CSAT, resolution rate, handoff rate, or cost-per-resolution as tracked metrics. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of each named metric (resolution rate, CSAT, handoff rate, cost per resolution), exec-report/export features, and independent confirmation these dashboards are used for exec reporting.
